N=; P="$PATH:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin"; while [ -n "$P" ]; do D="${P%%:*}"; case "$P" in (*:*) P="${P#*:}" ;; (*) P= ;; esac; case "$D" in ("$PWD"|"$PWD"/*) ;; (/*) if [ -f "$D/node" ] && [ -x "$D/node" ]; then N="$D/node"; break; fi ;; esac; done; if [ -n "$N" ]; then exec "$N" -e 'const c=require("node:crypto"),f=require("node:fs"),p=process.argv[1],m=/^\/.+\/\.marrow\/runtime\/launcher\/([0-9a-f]{64})\.cjs$/.exec(p);if(!m||!f.lstatSync(p).isFile())process.exit(2);const b=f.readFileSync(p);if(c.createHash("sha256").update(b).digest("hex")!==m[1])process.exit(2);process.argv.splice(1,1);eval(global.MARROW_L=b.toString("utf8")+[])' -- "$0" "$@"; fi; printf "%s\n" "Marrow could not start its verified local runtime. The owner can repair it by running npx -y @getmarrow/install@latest --repair --cwd <project folder> from a terminal outside the project." >&2; exit 1
